observations: Three photos show a black electronic keyboard with 61 keys, placed on artificial green grass.
The keyboard has a central control panel with multiple buttons, sliders, and a small display screen.
The keys appear to be in good condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The surface of the keys shows some minor scuffs and wear, especially on the white keys.
The control panel includes labeled buttons and sliders, with some text in English and possibly other languages.
The keyboard has two speaker grilles on either side of the control panel.
No power cord, stand, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Yamaha keyboard for children' and 'quality'.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
No video or photo shows the keyboard being played or buttons being pressed. Functionality cannot be confirmed from still images.
No adapter is visible in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed without seeing it.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not be functional (keys or buttons not working)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard being played, with keys being pressed and buttons being activated.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, stand, or other components)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

risks.risk: Physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., internal damage, cracked casing)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the keyboard's edges, corners, and underside, or a video showing the keyboard being moved or tilted.

proof_requests: Video clip showing the keyboard being played to verify all keys and buttons work.
Photo showing all included accessories (power adapter, stand, etc.).
Close-up photos of the keyboard's edges, corners, and underside to check for hidden damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
